services.title: Company Registration
services.shortDescription: Incorporate your Private Limited Company or LLP in India with end-to-end expert support.
services.description: Launch your business as a legally recognized Private Limited Company. This corporate structure provides limited liability protection to shareholders and enhances credibility with banks, investors, and clients.
benefits: Limited liability protection for personal assets
Greater credibility and legal recognition
Easy access to corporate loans and venture capital
Perpetual succession (entity continues independent of owners)
eligibility: Minimum 2 Directors
Minimum 2 Shareholders
At least one Director must be an Indian Resident
Registered office address within India
requiredDocuments: Aadhaar Card or Passport of directors
Bank statement/Utility bill of directors (not older than 2 months)
Proof of registered office (electricity bill & No Objection Certificate)

faqs.question: How long does incorporation take?
faqs.answer: Usually, the complete process of name approval, DSC, DIN, and incorporation takes 7 to 10 working days.

faqs.question: Is a physical office required?
faqs.answer: No, a residential address can be used as the registered office of the company.

services.title: GST Registration
services.shortDescription: Get your Goods and Services Tax registration and ensure tax compliance for your business.
services.description: Obtain your unique GSTIN to collect GST on sales and claim Input Tax Credits. GST registration is mandatory for businesses with turnover exceeding statutory thresholds.
benefits: Legally collect taxes from customers
Claim Input Tax Credit (ITC) on business purchases
Seamless inter-state trade of goods and services
Eligible to list products on e-commerce platforms
eligibility: Turnover exceeding 40 Lakhs for goods (20 Lakhs for services)
Any business conducting inter-state transactions
E-commerce operators and aggregators
requiredDocuments: Aadhaar Card of the primary promoter
Proof of business address (Rent agreement / Electricity bill)
Cancelled cheque leaf or bank statement

faqs.question: Is GST registration free?
faqs.answer: The government fee is 0 INR. The price charged covers the professional filing and processing costs.

faqs.question: Can I register voluntarily?
faqs.answer: Yes, any business can register voluntarily to claim Input Tax Credit even if turnover is below limits.

services.title: MSME Registration (Udyam)
services.shortDescription: Register under MSME to claim massive government subsidies, lower interest loans, and rebates.
services.description: Obtain your Udyam Certificate and register under the Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises Development Act to unlock government benefits and financial protections.
benefits: Collateral-free business loans from banks
Protection against delayed payments from buyers
Subsidies on patent and trademark filings
Rebates on electricity bills and barcode registrations
eligibility: Micro: Investment < 1 Cr & Turnover < 5 Cr
Small: Investment < 10 Cr & Turnover < 50 Cr
Medium: Investment < 50 Cr & Turnover < 250 Cr
requiredDocuments: Aadhaar Card of the proprietor or partner
Business start date & type of activities

faqs.question: How long is Udyam registration valid?
faqs.answer: MSME Udyam registration is lifetime valid and does not require renewal.

faqs.question: Does this apply to traders?
faqs.answer: Yes, retail and wholesale traders are eligible to register under MSME for credit support.

services.title: IEC Registration
services.shortDescription: Import Export Code registration required for importing and exporting goods or services from India.
services.description: Obtain your 10-digit Import Export Code (IEC) issued by the Directorate General of Foreign Trade (DGFT) to start global shipping and transactions.
benefits: Expand business globally in the international market
Unlock export incentives and customs benefits
Lifetime validity with no renewal requirements
Fully online digital application process
eligibility: Any individual, partnership, or company engaged in import/export
Required for customs clearance of shipments
Required by banks to send/receive foreign currencies
requiredDocuments: Cancelled cheque with printed name or Bank certificate

faqs.question: Do I need to file returns for IEC?
faqs.answer: No, there are no tax return filings required for IEC. You must only update your IEC details annually online.

services.title: FSSAI License
services.shortDescription: Get your food business license and registration to ensure safety compliance and food standard approvals.
services.description: Ensure food hygiene safety standards are met and obtain FSSAI Registration or State/Central License to legally distribute, manufacture, or pack food products.
benefits: Legal approval to operate food businesses in India
Improves food safety credibility with customers
Facilitates easy distribution, delivery, and online listings
Enables food quality testing and quality check certifications
eligibility: FSSAI Registration: Turnover < 12 Lakhs/year
State License: Turnover between 12 Lakhs and 20 Crores/year
Central License: Turnover > 20 Crores/year or importing food items
requiredDocuments: Layout and list of equipment (for manufacturers)

faqs.question: What is the validity period?
faqs.answer: FSSAI licenses can be issued for a duration of 1 to 5 years, depending on the fees paid.

services.title: Trade License
services.shortDescription: Municipal corporation trade license required to run commercial and industrial businesses locally.
services.description: Obtain a local trade license from your municipal corporation to certify that your business operation is in accordance with safety and local zoning laws.
benefits: Complies with municipal guidelines and zones
Avoids legal penalties and business closures
Ensures safety measures inside commercial spaces
Required for opening commercial current accounts
eligibility: Commercial establishments, retail stores, cafes, and hotels
Manufacturing units, workshops, and small factories
Owner/tenant must be over 18 years of age
requiredDocuments: Rent agreement or NOC from the landlord
Sanctioned layout plan of the trade area
Fire NOC or structural stability certificate (if applicable)

faqs.question: How often do I renew it?
faqs.answer: Trade licenses are generally renewed annually between March 31st and April 30th.

services.title: Factory License
services.shortDescription: Factory license approval for safety, employee health, and environmental compliance on manufacturing lines.
services.description: Register your manufacturing unit under the Factories Act, 1948. This ensures workers' health, safety, and welfare are monitored and compliant.
benefits: Legal permission to execute heavy manufacturing
Assures occupational health and safety benchmarks
Avoids heavy court penalties and machinery lockouts
Allows claiming government electrical/industrial subsidies
eligibility: Units employing 10 or more workers with power usage
Units employing 20 or more workers without power usage
requiredDocuments: Stability certificate from a qualified engineer
Director/Proprietor details and electricity load approvals

faqs.question: Is a site inspection mandatory?
faqs.answer: Yes, a factory inspector visits the site to verify layout plans and safety mock drills.

services.title: Pollution NOC
services.shortDescription: Pollution Consent to Establish (CTE) & Consent to Operate (CTO) from State Pollution Boards.
services.description: Secure Consent to Establish (CTE) and Consent to Operate (CTO) from your State Pollution Control Board to verify your emissions and waste systems.
benefits: Complies with environmental preservation acts
Allows operating factories and commercial kitchens
Certifies sound, air, and water waste processes
Protects against shutdown notices from environmental courts
eligibility: Manufacturing firms and industrial units
Hospitals and clinical laboratories
Hotels, large restaurants, and automobile service stations
requiredDocuments: Details of manufacturing process & chemical raw materials
Details of waste disposal systems (effluent treatment details)

faqs.question: What are red, orange, and green categories?
faqs.answer: Pollution boards classify industries based on pollution index; green is low, orange is moderate, and red is heavy.

services.title: Labour Registrations (PF & ESI)
services.shortDescription: Provident Fund (PF) and Employee State Insurance (ESI) registration for employee benefits.
services.description: Complete your corporate registration under EPFO and ESIC. This guarantees your employees receive statutory healthcare and pension benefits.
benefits: Statutory compliance for payroll and hiring
Employee retirement pension and medical cover
Avoids legal prosecution and interest penalties
Boosts organizational trust and employee retention
eligibility: PF registration: Mandatory for firms with 20 or more employees
ESI registration: Mandatory for firms with 10 or more employees
requiredDocuments: List of employees with date of joining
Digital Signature Certificate (DSC) of the authorized director

faqs.question: Can we register voluntarily?
faqs.answer: Yes, businesses with less than the limit can choose voluntary PF registration to benefit employees.

services.title: Fire NOC
services.shortDescription: Fire department safety certificate confirming fire protection system installations.
services.description: Obtain a Fire No Objection Certificate (Fire NOC) from the local fire department confirming that fire safety alarms, sprinklers, and exits are fully functional.
benefits: Guarantees protection against emergency hazards
Mandatory for schools, hospitals, and high-rise offices
Protects owners from liability in accidental damage
Required for claiming insurance payouts
eligibility: Buildings exceeding 15 meters in height
Commercial establishments like hotels, malls, and theaters
Warehouses storing hazardous chemicals or oils
requiredDocuments: Building plan drawings and layout plans
Details of installed fire fighting tools and extinguishers

faqs.question: Is a trial test conducted?
faqs.answer: Yes, fire safety officers execute a live inspection of sprinklers and alarms before approval.

services.title: ISO Certification
services.shortDescription: Get certified under ISO 9001, 14001, or 27001 to enhance standard quality audits.
services.description: Obtain global quality recognition with ISO Certification. Standardized systems like ISO 9001 (Quality) and ISO 27001 (Security) build client confidence.
benefits: Global standard quality recognition
Enables bidding on major government tenders
Improves internal operational processes
Crucial for software vendors and export manufacturers
eligibility: Any active business entity seeking quality validation
Requires establishing standard working guidelines
requiredDocuments: Invoice copy showing standard client transactions

faqs.question: What is the validity period?
faqs.answer: ISO certificates are valid for 3 years, with annual surveillance audits required.

services.title: Trademark Registration
services.shortDescription: Register your brand name, logo, or slogan to protect intellectual property.
services.description: Secure the TM symbol and brand name ownership. Trademark registration prevents competitors from copying your logos, brand names, and catchphrases.
benefits: Exclusive legal rights to your brand names & logos
Ability to sue competitors for trademark infringement
Builds brand value as an intangible asset
Enables listing on Amazon Brand Registry
eligibility: Individuals, companies, LLPs, or partnerships
Seeking logo, slogan, or word-mark protection
requiredDocuments: Proof of brand usage (if claiming prior use)

faqs.question: When can I use the TM and R symbols?
faqs.answer: You can use TM immediately after filing. The registered (R) symbol can only be used after approval (takes 9-12 months).

services.title: Startup India Registration
services.shortDescription: Get recognized under Startup India scheme to claim 3 years tax holiday and self-certifications.
services.description: Get recognized by DPIIT under the Startup India scheme to claim tax exemptions, patent rebates, and easy liquidation pathways.
benefits: Income tax exemption for 3 consecutive years
80% rebate on patent filings
Self-certification under labour and environmental laws
Easy winding-up (liquidation) in 90 days
eligibility: Incorporated as Pvt Ltd, LLP, or Partnership firm
Firms not older than 10 years from registration
Annual turnover below 100 Crores
requiredDocuments: Write-up explaining the innovative nature of the business
Pitch deck or website link showing products

faqs.question: Is tax exemption automatic?
faqs.answer: No, DPIIT recognition is automatic, but tax holiday (Section 80-IAC) requires separate approval from the Inter-Ministerial Board.

services.title: Professional Tax Registration
services.shortDescription: State professional tax registration mandatory for employers paying salaries.
services.description: Register under state professional tax departments to deduct tax from salaries and deposit it with the state government.
benefits: Complies with mandatory state tax rules
Avoids monthly compounding interest penalties
Seamless corporate compliance audit reporting
Low tax rates capped at 2500 per year
eligibility: Every employer paying salary exceeding statutory slabs
Professionals like doctors, lawyers, CAs, and consultants
requiredDocuments: Rent agreement & utility bill of the premises

faqs.question: Is it applicable in all states?
faqs.answer: No, professional tax is levied only in select states (e.g. Maharashtra, Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, West Bengal).

services.title: Shop & Establishment License (Gumasta)
services.shortDescription: Municipal license mandatory for shops, offices, and commercial establishments in municipal areas.
services.description: Obtain your Shop and Establishment registration to legalize your office, shop, or commercial workshop operating in a municipal region.
benefits: Serves as primary proof of business existence
Mandatory for opening commercial bank accounts
Allows access to local trade municipal benefits
Regulates working hours, weekly offs, and employee welfare
eligibility: Any shop, commercial office, restaurant, hotel, or warehouse
Operating within municipal boundary limits
requiredDocuments: Photo of the shop front (with name board in regional language)
Rates and tax receipt / utility bill of premises
PAN & Aadhaar card of the owner

faqs.question: Is this required for remote work?
faqs.answer: If you have a physical registered office or commercial cabin, yes, Shop Act registration is required in most municipal areas.
